sth_fishwife.text: You want the fishcake. Tuna, potato, a little onion and a lot of pepper, fried in a pan. Every family has its own version, and every family says its version is the only one.
Plo, now, is a rice dish, and it's on every table. Nobody will tell you how to spell it. Plo, plow, plough, whatever the sailors wrote.

sth_wharf.text: Everything comes in here by ship. Sugar, tea, tyres. The RMS St Helena, the old mail ship, did the run to Cape Town for years. Now it's the Saint Helena, a smaller and sturdier lady.
To land at Jamestown you used to hold a rope and be swung ashore from the boat. People still talk about the ones who missed.

sth_runner.text: Seven hundred steps, give or take the landing. I did it in under ten minutes, which is the island record for anyone with legs. I'm told the donkey could have done better.
The steps are steep. That's the point. If you can walk up them in your good shoes with a cake, you're a Saint.

sth_coffee.text: Green Tipped Bourbon Arabica, grown on the hills up top. The East India Company brought the first beans in 1733. A few hundred bushes at first, and now people pay a lot for our small crop.
Napoleon, they say, took coffee at Longwood. Whether it was ours or a good cup I can't swear.

sth_boy.text: We learn about Napoleon at school, and the Boer prisoners, and the ships. I was bored of it for years and then somebody said, you live on the most interesting rock in the world, and I thought, oh.
My granny can say 'one place, one people' in six ways and not one of them means anything bad.

st_helena_jamestown_return.text: The flight home goes from the new airport at Prosperous Bay, about a drive up and over the hill. They run a minibus. I'll sort you a seat.

st_helena_jamestown_bureau.text: Saint Helena pounds are at par with sterling. Shops here take your sterling, but everything paid out here comes in our own notes, which the mainland won't touch.

st_helena_jamestown_homebound.text: Heading back to the mainland? Passage to RAF Brize Norton can be arranged whenever you like. Bring your own sandwiches.
